newsitem.title: UK: MOTOR RACING-LOLA PULL OUT OF 1997 F1 CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LOLA PULL OUT OF 1997 F1 CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: The Lola Formula One motor racing team on Wednesday confirmed that they would be pulling out of this season's world championship.
The move came after several hours of intense activity at the Huntingdon-based team's factory following the announcement that they had withdrawn from this weekend's Brazilian Grand Prix.
A spokesman for the British team said Lola had pulled out because they could not predict the amount of money available to them for the remainder of the season.
